default_classification.title: Default Classification
default_classification.description: Default document classification (e.g. PUBLIC, OFFICIAL, OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE)

organisation_name.title: Organisation Name
organisation_name.description: Organisation or client name substituted into rendered artefacts (e.g. Federal Entity field)

project_issue_prefix.title: Project Issue Prefix
project_issue_prefix.description: Identifier prefix used for engagement/parent issue references in document control blocks and references

safety_checklist_id.title: Safety Checklist ID
safety_checklist_id.description: Identifier of the safety/compliance checklist referenced in governance-report.yaml (leave blank to use [PENDING] placeholder)

references_dir.title: External References Directory
references_dir.description: Directory containing external reference documents (e.g. ADRs, study notes). Leave blank to omit external references from rendered artefacts
